# Sawek (Blue Devil)

![[_assets/banners/sawek-banner.webp]]

[[kalowe|Kalowe]]'s reef divers call it the sawek; colonial sailors call it the blue devil, after its preference for the caves lining blue holes as its lair. The front half is shark: broad, muscle-dense, jaws wide enough to take a man at the shoulder, skin a deep blue-grey that reads as black in dim water. The rear half is octopus: eight tentacles, each up to twenty feet long at full extension. It fits inside a cave entrance that looks too small to hold anything of note.

The sawek is an ambush predator — the tentacles emerge from the entrance and grab whatever is within range, and the shark half takes over once prey is in reach. It can maintain a grapple on two targets at once and drags a grappled creature back toward its lair. While stationary in its lair, the sawek is silent and requires no Stealth check; a creature looking directly into the lair entrance needs a DC 18 Wisdom (Perception) check to spot movement in the dark below. It has advantage on Perception checks that rely on smell and breathes only underwater. [[kalowe|Kalowe]] divers mark claimed holes with a length of cord tied to a reef stake.

The [[kalowe-sawek-bounty|Kalowe — The Sawek Bounty]] quest carries a variant combat write-up for this creature (escape DC 14, an ink-cloud reaction, sunlight sensitivity) that isn't present in this bestiary entry's statblock below. Both are legacy-dated the same day, so treat the quest page's version as the tuned encounter build rather than a correction to this entry.
